film.title: The Freezer Hearing | A Hocking Miami Exclusive
film.description:
A pint of black raspberry chocolate chip, labeled on three sides, goes missing from the media room freezer at 7:14 p.m. A seventh-year walk-on in a wrestling singlet won't name names. A retired Bowling Green radio man in dark glasses will not stop talking. The compliance hearing is held in our studio, because it was the only room open.

With Gary Mercer, Simone Baptiste, Trevor Holloway, Claire Beaumont, Diane Okafor, Marcus Vance, Patty Gallagher and Ray Abernathy.

reels.text: How did a retired Bowling Green radio man get past the press gate and into the media room freezer? He walked in behind the pep band. From The Freezer Hearing, a Hocking Miami Exclusive.
